requirements: PAL A1200, 68EC020 interpreter, Alice/Lisa, 2 MiB Chip RAM, no slow/Fast RAM, one existing FFS HDF on unit 0 and empty floppy drives. No RTC, RTG or shared folders. Integrated E00000 graphics bank followed by F80000 reset bank; no companion extension ROM.
producerSourceSnapshot: Native Exec development snapshot: four-VBlank quantum and interrupt-return scheduling, full 68000/EC020 user context, higher-priority IRQ wake-ups and deferred Forbid/Disable attention; short native task transitions masked against interrupt mutation. Existing native list/signal/copy fast paths are now included in the reset snapshot. Desktop drawing and editor scans no longer call Schedule. Input wakes through IRQ-safe Signal and blocks on Wait at priority 20; gate contention uses ObtainSemaphore and owned task resources permit safe retirement. Layers protects its shared native boundary frame and coherent task-lock transitions. Paired expunge tails release exclusion in permanent code. Frozen GUI transport is adapted in isolation; unrelated newer provider features are excluded. Graphics bank, CPU/chipset code, compiler and package pins remain unchanged. New padded GUI/Home and launcher use exec-preemption.10 migration; recognized prior app system files upgrade with backup. Development qualification. Native idle-resume reserves the canonical saved-context slot across compiled scheduler work; sole-waiter wake-up controls fail before and pass after on both CPUs. The permanent console now drains packets and blocks on port/keyboard/timed-read signals; its cooked/raw handoff excludes task switches. Long console deadlines block on VBlank signals; their final field retains raster polling for sub-field timeout resolution. Native user-mode IPL-7 transactions also defer NMI-triggered scheduling.
